'''Phetaril''' was a form of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] that was used by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]]<ref name="SWI 67" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Following that event, the [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] [[Musician/Legends|singer]] [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] toured a string of seedy [[Cantina/Legends|bars]] along the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and ended up meeting the [[Spiner]] [[Quilsen]], a down-and-out individual who introduced Snootles to phetaril. From that point onward, Snootles drowned her sorrows in the spice.<ref name="SWI 67" />

==Behind the scenes==
Phetaril was mentioned in "[[Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band]]," an article [[Rich Handley]] wrote for the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="SWI 67" /> that was released on [[April 15]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate <i>Jedi</i>'s 20th in ''Insider'' #67}}</ref>
